florian.title: Hi, I'm Florian, the creator of REVS.
florian.body:
I created REVS first and foremost out of a passion for cars, but also with one goal in mind: bringing enthusiasts together around a single community.

Whether you're a carspotter, into F1, motorbikes, classic cars, sports cars or supercars, or simply someone who loves beautiful cars, REVS is made for everyone with a connection to the automotive world.

I wanted to build a place where we can discover, share, collect and live our passion together.
florian.closing: One passion. One community. One place: REVS.

section1.heading: 1. Purpose
section1.body: REVS is a community car-spotting app that lets you photograph, geolocate and share the cars you spot, follow auto/F1 news and take part in events. Using the app implies full and complete acceptance of these terms.

section2.heading: 2. Access conditions
section2.body: The app is reserved for people aged at least 13. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity from your account.

section3.heading: 3. Community rules
section3.body: The following are prohibited: any unlawful, defamatory or hateful content, or content that infringes on others' privacy (identifiable people, license plates, private property); spam and solicitation; fake photos (screenshots, thumbnails, 3D renders, images not captured live). Spot while respecting traffic laws and your own safety — never take photos while driving. Any breach may result in the removal of content or of the account.

section4.heading: 4. User content
section4.body: You remain the owner of your photos and stay responsible for the content you publish. You grant REVS a non-exclusive license to host and display this content within the app.

section5.heading: 5. Subscriptions and refunds
section5.body: Paid monthly subscriptions via Stripe: Starter €3, Premium €8, VIP €25 per month. Renewal is automatic each month; you can cancel at any time, with cancellation taking effect at the end of the current period. In accordance with consumer law, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal; by requesting immediate access to the paid features, you accept the immediate performance of the service and the loss of the right of withdrawal once the service has been fully provided. No pro-rata refund is due for a period already started.

section6.heading: 6. Liability
section6.body: REVS is provided "as is", with no guarantee of continuous availability. REVS cannot be held liable for content published by users, nor for any dangerous or illegal use of the app. The publisher's liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.

section7.heading: 7. Applicable law and jurisdiction
section7.body: These terms are governed by French law. Failing an amicable resolution, any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the courts of Annecy.

section8.heading: 8. Changes to the terms
section8.body: REVS may modify these terms. The version in force is the one published in the app; continued use constitutes acceptance of the changes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.disclaimer: GDPR template to be validated by legal counsel before going to production. The DPO/contact email is to be filled in.

controller.heading: Data controller
controller.body: REVS — Florian Burnier, Annecy, France. Contact / DPO: [email à renseigner].

data.heading: Data collected
data.body: Email address (account); username and city (profile); photos of spotted cars; geolocation associated with each spot and event; activity and gamification data (XP, badges, likes, comments, subscriptions). Consent preferences (analytics, marketing) are stored on your device.

purposes.heading: Purposes and legal basis
purposes.body: Providing the service (map, feed, leaderboard, events, notifications) — performance of the contract. Audience measurement and marketing communications — only on the basis of your consent, which can be withdrawn at any time in Settings → Privacy & legal.

retention.heading: Retention period
retention.body: Account data is kept as long as the account is active and is deleted upon request or when the account is deleted. Spots automatically expire after 1 h if they receive no interaction; news after 24 h.

recipients.heading: Recipients and processors
recipients.body: Supabase (database / storage, European Union); Vercel Inc. (application hosting, United States); Stripe (subscription payments); Anthropic (image analysis for car recognition). No data is resold.

transfers.heading: Transfers outside the European Union
transfers.body: Application hosting (Vercel Inc., USA) involves a transfer of data outside the EU, governed by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

cookies.heading: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: Strictly technical cookies/storage: Supabase authentication session, app preferences. Audience measurement and marketing communications are only enabled with your explicit consent (Settings).

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: In accordance with the GDPR: rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction and objection. You can delete your account from Settings → Danger zone: this permanently erases your profile, spots, photos and comments. Technical logs held by our hosting providers (Supabase, Vercel) follow their own retention periods. To exercise your rights: [email à renseigner]. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).

mentions.title: Legal Notice
mentions.disclaimer: The contact email address is to be filled in by the publisher before public production release.

hosting.heading: Hosting
hosting.db: Database and file storage: Supabase, hosted in the European Union.

ip.heading: Intellectual property
ip.body: The REVS brand, design and code are protected. The photos and content published remain the property of their authors, who grant REVS a license to display them within the app.

report.heading: Reporting
report.body: Any unlawful content can be reported to the contact address above for removal as soon as possible.

s1.title: Welcome to REVS.
s1.body: The app for car enthusiasts. Spot the cars around you, collect them, level up, and share your passion.

s2.title: Spotting is the heart of REVS
s2.body: Seen an interesting car? Take a photo. REVS can identify it for you — or you fill it in yourself.
s2.note: AI analysis is a help, never a requirement: you can always enter the details manually.

s3.title: Your collection grows
s3.body: Every car you spot becomes a card. The rarer it is, the more it counts.
s3.b3: Six rarity tiers, from Common to Legendary

s4.title: The map
s4.body: Discover cars spotted around you. New Spots appear on the map for one hour, then make way for the next ones.
s4.note: The displayed position is deliberately approximate.

s5.title: The community
s5.body: The Feed gathers other enthusiasts' Spots. See their finds, react, and share your own.

s6.title: Formula 1
s6.body: REVS follows the season: the Grand Prix calendar, the teams, the drivers and paddock news.

s7.title: News and events
s7.body: Stay connected to the car world. News is refreshed every morning, and meets near you are listed.

s8.title: The brands
s8.body: Explore manufacturers, their models and their world. Every brand has its page.

s9.title: Your profile
s9.body: Your profile brings together all your progress: your level, your XP, your Garage, your Collection and your badges.

s10.title: Over to you.
s10.body: Go find new cars, complete your collection and join the REVS community.
